example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসের রামভক্ত হনুমানের মতো অনুগত।
এই প্রকল্পে তার ভূমিকা ছিল রামভক্ত হনুমানের মতো সাহায্যকারী।
example_sentences_in_english: He is as devoted to his boss as Hanuman to Ram.
His role in the project was like a loyal follower, akin to Hanuman the devotee of Ram.
history: This idiom draws from the Ramayana epic, where Hanuman is portrayed as the ultimate devotee and loyal servant of Lord Rama, symbolizing unwavering faith and service.
note: The idiom is rooted in Hindu mythology and is widely used in Bengali to denote absolute loyalty.
